title: Best Yaufey Dehumidifier (2026): Models, Reviews & Manual Tips
dek: A basement-and-crawl-space specialist with one standout model, one budget unit to inspect on arrival, and a clean recall record.
description: The best Yaufey dehumidifier for rooms, basements and crawl spaces: the 30-, 70- and 125-pint models compared, plus what owner reviews actually report.
intro: A Yaufey dehumidifier is a different proposition from the generic towers sold by big online importers. The Gaffney, South Carolina, company pitches itself as a basement and crawl-space specialist, and its lineup reflects that: a small room unit, a pump-equipped basement model and a purpose-built crawl-space machine with a roto-molded, corrosion-resistant housing. The company also makes bold marketing claims about patents, repair centers and millions of customers — figures we can't verify independently.

The owner-review picture is mixed in a useful way. The budget 30-pint model draws a notable share of out-of-box failure reports, while the 70-pint basement unit carries ENERGY STAR certification, a five-year warranty and strong marks from reviewers for crawl-space and commercial use.
We built this guide from manufacturer specs and manuals, ENERGY STAR listings, the CPSC recall database and patterns in owner and independent reviews. We don't lab-test dehumidifiers ourselves.
topPicksLead: The **Yaufey 70-Pint (AYD1.5DPM)** is the strongest buy in the lineup — a pump-equipped, ENERGY STAR basement unit with a five-year warranty — while the **Yaufey 30-Pint** is the entry point for a single room.

products.name: Yaufey 30-Pint Dehumidifier
pros: Humidistat adjusts in 5% steps from 30% to 80%
1–24 hour timer and two fan speeds
Rated for spaces up to 1,500 sq ft
products.whyWeLoveIt: It's the affordable way into Yaufey's lineup, with a proper digital humidistat, timer and auto-defrost — features that some budget rivals skip. For a bedroom, home office or small basement room, 30 pints a day is the right scale.
products.performance: The tiny 3.8-pint tank is the practical catch: at full output it needs emptying several times a day, so most owners will want to run the continuous gravity-drain hose. The bigger concern is quality control — a pattern of reports describes units that didn't work on arrival, some linked to compressor damage from being shipped on their side. Inspect it, let it stand upright for several hours, then test it while you're still inside the return window.
products.notes: Keep the box until you've confirmed the unit runs and collects water. Compare similar units from other brands in our [best small dehumidifier](/best/best-small-dehumidifier/) guide.

products.name: Yaufey 70-Pint Dehumidifier with Pump (AYD1.5DPM)
pros: ENERGY STAR certified at a listed 265 W
Five-year warranty backed by TUV certification
Rated for up to 5,000 sq ft
cons: No Wi-Fi, app or sleep mode
products.whyWeLoveIt: This is the Yaufey we'd actually recommend. It pumps condensate up and out of a below-grade basement with no tank to watch, it's ENERGY STAR certified, and its five-year warranty is far longer than the one-year coverage common among budget import brands.
products.performance: Reviewers who focus on crawl-space and commercial use rate it highly; its scores dip in consumer roundups mainly because it lacks smart features, a second fan speed and a quiet mode — not because of drying performance or build quality. The 16.4-foot hose can run vertically to a window or sink. For how it stacks up against other basement units, see our [best dehumidifier for basement](/best/best-dehumidifier-for-basement/) guide.
products.notes: Retailers have listed the 70-pint tier under several SKUs. Confirm the exact model number before you order.

products.name: Yaufey 125-Pint Crawlspace Dehumidifier with Pump (AYD2.0DPM)
pros: Purpose-built for sealed, low-clearance crawl spaces
Typically priced below AlorAir and Aprilaire equivalents
cons: Shorter independent track record than the category leaders
Overkill for anything but a crawl space or large basement
products.whyWeLoveIt: Crawl spaces are hard to reach, so a unit that drains itself and shrugs off damp, dirty conditions is the whole point. This model is designed for that job rather than adapted from a room dehumidifier.
products.performance: Yaufey rates it at 125 pints a day and builds it in the same rugged housing style as dedicated crawl-space brands. It generally costs less than comparable AlorAir and Aprilaire units, though those brands have a longer record in this category. Compare them in our [best crawl space dehumidifier](/best/best-crawl-space-dehumidifier/) guide and our [AlorAir vs. Aprilaire](/compare/alorair-vs-aprilaire-dehumidifier/) head-to-head, and see our [crawl space installation guide](/guides/crawl-space-dehumidifier-installation/) before you set one up.

blocks.text: That clean recall record is worth noting, but Yaufey is a younger, lower-volume brand than names like Frigidaire or GE, so it carries less weight than it would for a company that's shipped millions of units over decades.

We compared each current model on manufacturer specifications (capacity, coverage, humidistat range, drainage and wattage), confirmed ENERGY STAR status model by model, and searched the CPSC recall database. Because Yaufey's own marketing claims can't be independently checked, we gave more weight to verifiable certifications and warranty terms.

We then read owner and independent reviews looking for repeated patterns — particularly the out-of-box failures reported on the 30-pint unit — rather than isolated complaints. We don't run hands-on lab tests; everything here comes from published data and reported owner experience.

sections.heading: What to look for in a Yaufey dehumidifier

items.label: The right model for the space
items.text: Yaufey segments by use: 30 pints for a room, 70 for a basement, 125 for a crawl space. Choose by the job, not the biggest number.

items.label: A plan for drainage
items.text: The 30-pint's small tank makes a gravity hose almost mandatory. The 70- and 125-pint models pump water out on their own.

items.label: ENERGY STAR on the exact model
items.text: The 70-pint is certified; don't assume the rest of the lineup is.

items.label: Warranty length
items.text: The 70-pint's five-year coverage is a real advantage over the one-year terms common with budget brands.

items.label: An inspection on arrival
items.text: Especially for the 30-pint: check for shipping damage, let it rest upright, then run it right away.

sections.heading: Yaufey dehumidifier reviews: what owners report

blocks.text: Owner feedback splits cleanly by model. On the **30-pint**, the recurring complaint is units that arrive dead or fail within days. Some of those reports trace back to compressors damaged when boxes were shipped or stored on their side — a risk with any sealed-refrigerant appliance, but one that shows up often enough with this unit to plan around.

The **70-pint AYD1.5DPM** fares much better. Reviewers who evaluate units for crawl spaces and commercial spaces score it well for drying and build quality. Where it loses points in consumer roundups, it's for missing conveniences: no Wi-Fi, a single fan speed and no sleep mode for living areas.

items: **Let it stand upright before first use.** Like all compressor units, give it several hours after delivery so oil settles back into the compressor — longer if it arrived on its side.
**Set the humidistat, not just the fan.** Aim for 45–50% in basements; our [humidistat settings guide](/guides/dehumidifier-humidistat-settings-guide/) explains seasonal targets.
**Clean the filter regularly** and check the pump hose for kinks on pump models. Our [maintenance guide](/guides/dehumidifier-maintenance/) covers the routine.
**Lost your manual?** Yaufey's website and its customer support team are the place to request a copy for your exact model number.

blocks.text: The **Yaufey 70-Pint AYD1.5DPM** is the best Yaufey dehumidifier and a strong basement buy in general: a built-in pump, ENERGY STAR certification and a five-year warranty, if not much in the way of smart features. The **30-Pint** is a reasonable room unit as long as you inspect and test it the day it arrives. The **125-Pint Crawlspace** model is a lower-cost alternative to the category leaders for sealed crawl spaces. To cross-shop against brands with longer track records, see our [dehumidifier brands](/best/best-dehumidifier-brands/) roundup.

faqs.q: What is the best Yaufey dehumidifier?
faqs.a: For most buyers, the Yaufey 70-Pint (AYD1.5DPM): a basement unit with a built-in pump and 16.4-foot hose, ENERGY STAR certification and a five-year warranty. For a single small room, the 30-pint is the entry point, and the 125-pint AYD2.0DPM is built for crawl spaces.

faqs.q: Are Yaufey dehumidifiers reliable? What do reviews say?
faqs.a: Reviews are mixed by model. The 30-pint draws a noticeable number of out-of-box failure reports, some tied to shipping damage. The 70-pint AYD1.5DPM gets strong marks for crawl-space and commercial use and carries a TUV-backed five-year warranty.

Yaufey is a dehumidifier-focused brand headquartered in Gaffney, South Carolina. It positions itself as a crawl-space and basement specialist rather than a general home-goods importer. Claims about its patents and customer numbers come from the company and haven't been independently verified.
The 70-pint AYD1.5DPM is, with a listed draw of 265 watts. Don't assume every model is; check the ENERGY STAR listing for the specific model number you're buying.

faqs.q: Does the Yaufey 70-pint dehumidifier have a pump?
faqs.a: Yes. The AYD1.5DPM has a built-in condensate pump and a 16.4-foot hose that can push water upward to a window or sink. The 125-pint crawl-space model also has a pump; the 30-pint drains only by gravity hose or its small tank.

faqs.q: Where can I find a Yaufey dehumidifier manual?
faqs.a: Start with Yaufey's website and customer support, and have your exact model number ready, since retailers sell the same capacity under several SKUs. The basics apply to every model: let it stand upright before first use, set the humidistat to 45–50% and clean the filter regularly.

faqs.q: Has a Yaufey dehumidifier ever been recalled?
faqs.a: No dehumidifier recall tied to the Yaufey name appears in the CPSC's records. Yaufey is a newer, smaller brand than legacy names that have had recalls, so the clean record is encouraging but not conclusive.
